intro.quote: Certificates and CRLs conforming to [RFC 3280] may be signed with any public key signature algorithm. The certificate or CRL indicates the algorithm through an algorithm identifier which appears in the signatureAlgorithm field within the Certificate or CertificateList. This algorithm identifier is an OID and has optionally associated parameters.

fields.name: algorithm
fields.explain: The algorithm field identifies the signature algorithm with an ASN.1 object identifier.

cite.quote: The certificate or CRL indicates the algorithm through an algorithm identifier which appears in the signatureAlgorithm field within the Certificate or CertificateList.

fields.name: parameters
fields.explain: The parameters field is optional and carries values associated with the selected algorithm.
